mechanism.claim: In a high-variation completed BTC path, a causal upper-tail increase in the share of Haar detail energy carried by the three coarsest dyadic scales identifies locally organized multiscale repricing rather than fine-scale churn. Follow the completed path direction for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the sum of the 128 completed five-minute returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVLFER used global DFT low-frequency energy over a full day; HVTPTF used linear time-price fit; HVSAR used lag-one return dependence; path classifiers fit outcomes. HVHCEM uses a dependency-free orthonormal Haar pyramid, localized non-overlapping 10h40m paths, and the change in coarse detail-energy share. It reuses no event set, control, model, flow, volume, funding, OI, premium, or external asset.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed path variation must rank in its causal upper 35% and coarse-scale energy migration in its upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse endogenous 00:05/12:05 UTC dyadic-energy migration clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.path: 128 exact contiguous completed BTCUSDT five-minute returns over [decision-10h40m,decision), built from 640 exact coherent one-minute bars
features.five_minute_return: log(last close/first open) for each exact five-row aggregate
features.haar_pyramid: at each level pair adjacent values as approximation=(left+right)/sqrt(2), detail=(left-right)/sqrt(2), recursively through seven levels; no padding or library dependency
features.detail_energy_by_level: sum squared detail coefficients for levels 1 through 7, where level 1 is finest and level 7 coarsest
features.coarse_energy_share: sum detail energies at levels 5,6,7 divided by sum detail energies at all seven levels; denominator strict positive
features.coarse_energy_migration: current coarse_energy_share minus immediately previous source-valid boundary share; strict positive
features.migration_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 previous valid migrations, minimum 252, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 previous valid paths, minimum 252, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact boundary after all 640 source minutes complete
clock.reservation: fixed half-day decisions; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_rv20: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all stages pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent deterministic localized Haar coarse-energy migration

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no scale, rank, side, hold, clock, window, subset, or control repair.
